texts.title: 认识新朋友
texts.content: 你好！我叫王明。我是学生，很高兴认识你。你叫什么名字？
texts.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ jiào Wáng Míng. Wǒ shì xuésheng, hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ. Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
texts.meaning: Hello! My name is Wang Ming. I am a student. Nice to meet you. What is your name?

texts.title: 来自哪里
texts.content: 你是哪国人？我是中国人。我也很喜欢学习中文。
texts.pinyin: Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén? Wǒ shì Zhōngguó rén. Wǒ yě hěn xǐhuan xuéxí Zhōngwén.
texts.meaning: What country are you from? I am Chinese. I also really like studying Chinese.

texts.title: 在教室里
texts.content: 老师好！我们今天学习汉语。请坐，也请打开书。
texts.pinyin: Lǎoshī hǎo! Wǒmen jīntiān xuéxí Hànyǔ. Qǐng zuò, yě qǐng dǎkāi shū.
texts.meaning: Hello, teacher! We study Chinese today. Please sit down, and please open the book.

texts.title: 我的家
texts.content: 我家有四个人。爸爸是医生，妈妈是老师。我还有一个妹妹。
texts.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu sì ge rén. Bàba shì yīshēng, māma shì lǎoshī. Wǒ hái yǒu yí ge mèimei.
texts.meaning: There are four people in my family. My father is a doctor, and my mother is a teacher. I also have a younger sister.

texts.title: 我的房间
texts.content: 我的房间不大，但是很漂亮。桌子上有一本书。窗户旁边有一把椅子。
texts.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān bú dà, dànshì hěn piàoliang. Zhuōzi shàng yǒu yì běn shū. Chuānghu pángbiān yǒu yì bǎ yǐzi.
texts.meaning: My room is not big, but it is very nice. There is a book on the table. There is a chair beside the window.

texts.title: 一起吃饭
texts.content: 晚上我们一家人一起吃饭。爸爸喜欢吃米饭，妈妈喜欢吃面条。我喜欢吃水果，也喜欢喝茶。
texts.pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒmen yì jiā rén yìqǐ chīfàn. Bàba xǐhuan chī mǐfàn, māma xǐhuan chī miàntiáo. Wǒ xǐhuan chī shuǐguǒ, yě xǐhuan hē chá.
texts.meaning: In the evening, my whole family eats together. Dad likes rice, and Mom likes noodles. I like eating fruit, and I also like drinking tea.

texts.title: 早上起床
texts.content: 我每天早上七点起床。我先洗脸，然后吃早饭。八点我去学校。
texts.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng. Wǒ xiān xǐ liǎn, ránhòu chī zǎofàn. Bā diǎn wǒ qù xuéxiào.
texts.meaning: I get up at seven every morning. I wash my face first, then eat breakfast. At eight I go to school.

texts.title: 在学校
texts.content: 上午我有三节课。中午我和朋友一起吃午饭。下午我们学习中文。
texts.pinyin: Shàngwǔ wǒ yǒu sān jié kè. Zhōngwǔ wǒ hé péngyou yìqǐ chī wǔfàn. Xiàwǔ wǒmen xuéxí Zhōngwén.
texts.meaning: I have three classes in the morning. At noon I have lunch with my friends. In the afternoon we study Chinese.

texts.title: 晚上回家
texts.content: 下午五点我回家。晚上我做作业，也看书。十点半我睡觉。
texts.pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn wǒ huí jiā. Wǎnshang wǒ zuò zuòyè, yě kàn shū. Shí diǎn bàn wǒ shuìjiào.
texts.meaning: I go home at five in the afternoon. In the evening I do homework and also read. I go to sleep at half past ten.

texts.title: 在餐厅
texts.content: 我和朋友去餐厅吃饭。我想吃牛肉面，你想吃什么？请给我一杯水。
texts.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyou qù cāntīng chīfàn. Wǒ xiǎng chī niúròu miàn, nǐ xiǎng chī shénme? Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi shuǐ.
texts.meaning: My friend and I go to a restaurant to eat. I want beef noodles. What do you want to eat? Please give me a glass of water.

texts.title: 买水果
texts.content: 今天的苹果多少钱一斤？这个太贵了，有便宜一点的吗？那我买两个，谢谢。
texts.pinyin: Jīntiān de píngguǒ duōshao qián yì jīn? Zhège tài guì le, yǒu piányi yìdiǎn de ma? Nà wǒ mǎi liǎng ge, xièxie.
texts.meaning: How much are the apples per 500 grams today? These are too expensive. Is there a cheaper option? Then I’ll buy two. Thank you.

texts.title: 在商店
texts.content: 我想买一件白色的衣服。这件衣服有大一点的吗？可以，我试一下。
texts.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí jiàn báisè de yīfu. Zhè jiàn yīfu yǒu dà yìdiǎn de ma? Kěyǐ, wǒ shì yíxià.
texts.meaning: I want to buy a white item of clothing. Do you have this in a larger size? Sure, I’ll try it on.

texts.title: 今天天气
texts.content: 今天天气很好，太阳出来了。但是下午可能会下雨。所以我带了一把雨伞。
texts.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, tàiyáng chūlái le. Dànshì xiàwǔ kěnéng huì xiàyǔ. Suǒyǐ wǒ dài le yì bǎ yǔsǎn.
texts.meaning: The weather is good today, and the sun has come out. But it may rain in the afternoon. So I brought an umbrella.

texts.title: 怎么去学校
texts.content: 你每天怎么去学校？我通常坐公交车去。如果不下雨，我有时候骑自行车。
texts.pinyin: Nǐ měitiān zěnme qù xuéxiào? Wǒ tōngcháng zuò gōngjiāochē qù. Rúguǒ bù xiàyǔ, wǒ yǒushíhou qí zìxíngchē.
texts.meaning: How do you go to school every day? I usually take the bus. If it doesn't rain, I sometimes ride a bicycle.

texts.title: 周末出门
texts.content: 周六早上我要和朋友出去。我们先去公园，然后去商店。晚上八点以前我会回家。
texts.pinyin: Zhōuliù zǎoshang wǒ yào hé péngyou chūqù. Wǒmen xiān qù gōngyuán, ránhòu qù shāngdiàn. Wǎnshang bā diǎn yǐqián wǒ huì huí jiā.
texts.meaning: On Saturday morning I am going out with my friend. We will go to the park first, then to the shop. I will go home before eight in the evening.

texts.title: 我的爱好
texts.content: 我最喜欢听音乐。我也喜欢看电影和打篮球。你有什么爱好？
texts.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan tīng yīnyuè. Wǒ yě xǐhuan kàn diànyǐng hé dǎ lánqiú. Nǐ yǒu shénme àihào?
texts.meaning: I like listening to music the most. I also like watching movies and playing basketball. What hobbies do you have?

texts.title: 学习汉语
texts.content: 我学习汉语已经一年了。现在我会说一些简单的句子。虽然有时候很难，但是我不想放弃。
texts.pinyin: Wǒ xuéxí Hànyǔ yǐjīng yì nián le. Xiànzài wǒ huì shuō yìxiē jiǎndān de jùzi. Suīrán yǒushíhou hěn nán, dànshì wǒ bù xiǎng fàngqì.
texts.meaning: I have been studying Chinese for one year. Now I can say some simple sentences. Although it is sometimes difficult, I don't want to give up.

texts.title: 周末计划
texts.content: 这个周末你有什么计划？我打算在家休息，也想看一本书。如果天气不错，我还想和朋友踢足球。
texts.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò nǐ yǒu shénme jìhuà? Wǒ dǎsuàn zài jiā xiūxi, yě xiǎng kàn yì běn shū. Rúguǒ tiānqì búcuò, wǒ hái xiǎng hé péngyou tī zúqiú.
texts.meaning: What plans do you have this weekend? I plan to rest at home and also want to read a book. If the weather is good, I also want to play football with my friends.

texts.title: 学习计划
texts.content: 为了学好汉语，我每天都会复习。我把生词写在本子上。晚上我会读课文，然后做练习。
texts.pinyin: Wèile xuéhǎo Hànyǔ, wǒ měitiān dōu huì fùxí. Wǒ bǎ shēngcí xiě zài běnzi shàng. Wǎnshang wǒ huì dú kèwén, ránhòu zuò liànxí.
texts.meaning: To learn Chinese well, I review every day. I write new words in my notebook. In the evening I read the text, then do exercises.

texts.title: 我的工作
texts.content: 我现在在一家工厂学习和工作。我的工作和机器有关。我希望以后能成为一名工程师。
texts.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài zài yì jiā gōngchǎng xuéxí hé gōngzuò. Wǒ de gōngzuò hé jīqì yǒuguān. Wǒ xīwàng yǐhòu néng chéngwéi yì míng gōngchéngshī.
texts.meaning: I am currently studying and working at a factory. My work is related to machines. I hope to become an engineer in the future.

texts.title: 解决问题
texts.content: 机器出了问题，我们马上去检查。我们先找到原因，再决定怎么修。只要认真工作，很多问题都可以解决。
texts.pinyin: Jīqì chū le wèntí, wǒmen mǎshàng qù jiǎnchá. Wǒmen xiān zhǎodào yuányīn, zài juédìng zěnme xiū. Zhǐyào rènzhēn gōngzuò, hěn duō wèntí dōu kěyǐ jiějué.
texts.meaning: The machine has developed a problem, so we go to inspect it right away. First we find the cause, then decide how to repair it. If we work carefully, many problems can be solved.

texts.title: 身体健康
texts.content: 最近我有点累，所以每天早点睡觉。我也每天喝很多水。身体健康比什么都重要。
texts.pinyin: Zuìjìn wǒ yǒudiǎn lèi, suǒyǐ měitiān zǎodiǎn shuìjiào. Wǒ yě měitiān hē hěn duō shuǐ. Shēntǐ jiànkāng bǐ shénme dōu zhòngyào.
texts.meaning: Recently I have been a little tired, so I go to bed earlier every day. I also drink plenty of water every day. Good health is more important than anything.

texts.title: 运动习惯
texts.content: 我以前不喜欢运动。现在我每周跑步三次。运动以后，我觉得精神多了。
texts.pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián bù xǐhuan yùndòng. Xiànzài wǒ měi zhōu pǎobù sān cì. Yùndòng yǐhòu, wǒ juéde jīngshen duō le.
texts.meaning: I didn't like exercising before. Now I run three times a week. After exercising, I feel much more energetic.

texts.title: 健康的生活
texts.content: 除了运动，我还注意每天的饮食。我少喝甜饮料，多吃蔬菜和水果。这样做虽然不容易，但是对身体很好。
texts.pinyin: Chúle yùndòng, wǒ hái zhùyì měitiān de yǐnshí. Wǒ shǎo hē tián yǐnliào, duō chī shūcài hé shuǐguǒ. Zhèyàng zuò suīrán bù róngyì, dànshì duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
texts.meaning: Besides exercise, I also pay attention to my daily diet. I drink fewer sweet drinks and eat more vegetables and fruit. Although this is not easy, it is good for the body.

texts.title: 准备旅行
texts.content: 下个月我准备去北京旅行。我已经买好了火车票。出发以前，我还要准备行李。
texts.pinyin: Xià ge yuè wǒ zhǔnbèi qù Běijīng lǚxíng. Wǒ yǐjīng mǎi hǎo le huǒchē piào. Chūfā yǐqián, wǒ hái yào zhǔnbèi xíngli.
texts.meaning: Next month I plan to travel to Beijing. I have already bought the train ticket. Before leaving, I still need to prepare my luggage.

texts.title: 在北京
texts.content: 到了北京以后，我先去酒店。第二天我想去看看长城。如果时间够，我们也可以去博物馆。
texts.pinyin: Dàole Běijīng yǐhòu, wǒ xiān qù jiǔdiàn. Dì èr tiān wǒ xiǎng qù kànkan Chángchéng. Rúguǒ shíjiān gòu, wǒmen yě kěyǐ qù bówùguǎn.
texts.meaning: After arriving in Beijing, I’ll go to the hotel first. The next day, I want to visit the Great Wall. If we have enough time, we can also visit a museum.

texts.title: 旅行结束以后
texts.content: 这次旅行让我学到了很多东西。我觉得旅行不只是看风景。认识不同的人和地方也很有意思。
texts.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng ràng wǒ xuédào le hěn duō dōngxi. Wǒ juéde lǚxíng bù zhǐshì kàn fēngjǐng. Rènshi bùtóng de rén hé dìfang yě hěn yǒu yìsi.
texts.meaning: This trip taught me a lot. I think travelling is not only about seeing scenery. Meeting different people and discovering different places are interesting too.

sentences.content: 我们先去公园，然后去商店。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān qù gōngyuán, ránhòu qù shāngdiàn.
sentences.meaning: We will go to the park first, then to the shop.

sentences.content: 晚上八点以前我会回家。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshang bā diǎn yǐqián wǒ huì huí jiā.
sentences.meaning: I will go home before eight in the evening.

sentences.content: 我最喜欢听音乐。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan tīng yīnyuè.
sentences.meaning: I like listening to music the most.

sentences.content: 我也喜欢看电影和打篮球。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yě xǐhuan kàn diànyǐng hé dǎ lánqiú.
sentences.meaning: I also like watching movies and playing basketball.

sentences.content: 你有什么爱好？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme àihào?
sentences.meaning: What hobbies do you have?

sentences.content: 我学习汉语已经一年了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xuéxí Hànyǔ yǐjīng yì nián le.
sentences.meaning: I have been studying Chinese for one year.

sentences.content: 现在我会说一些简单的句子。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ huì shuō yìxiē jiǎndān de jùzi.
sentences.meaning: Now I can say some simple sentences.

sentences.content: 虽然有时候很难，但是我不想放弃。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán yǒushíhou hěn nán, dànshì wǒ bù xiǎng fàngqì.
sentences.meaning: Although it is sometimes difficult, I don't want to give up.

sentences.content: 这个周末你有什么计划？
sentences.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò nǐ yǒu shénme jìhuà?
sentences.meaning: What plans do you have this weekend?

sentences.content: 我打算在家休息，也想看一本书。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn zài jiā xiūxi, yě xiǎng kàn yì běn shū.
sentences.meaning: I plan to rest at home and also want to read a book.

sentences.content: 如果天气不错，我还想和朋友踢足球。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ tiānqì búcuò, wǒ hái xiǎng hé péngyou tī zúqiú.
sentences.meaning: If the weather is good, I also want to play football with my friends.

sentences.content: 为了学好汉语，我每天都会复习。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile xuéhǎo Hànyǔ, wǒ měitiān dōu huì fùxí.
sentences.meaning: To learn Chinese well, I review every day.

sentences.content: 我把生词写在本子上。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ shēngcí xiě zài běnzi shàng.
sentences.meaning: I write new words in my notebook.

sentences.content: 晚上我会读课文，然后做练习。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒ huì dú kèwén, ránhòu zuò liànxí.
sentences.meaning: In the evening I read the text, then do exercises.

sentences.content: 我现在在一家工厂学习和工作。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài zài yì jiā gōngchǎng xuéxí hé gōngzuò.
sentences.meaning: I am currently studying and working at a factory.

sentences.content: 我的工作和机器有关。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de gōngzuò hé jīqì yǒuguān.
sentences.meaning: My work is related to machines.

sentences.content: 我希望以后能成为一名工程师。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng yǐhòu néng chéngwéi yì míng gōngchéngshī.
sentences.meaning: I hope to become an engineer in the future.

sentences.content: 机器出了问题，我们马上去检查。
sentences.pinyin: Jīqì chū le wèntí, wǒmen mǎshàng qù jiǎnchá.
sentences.meaning: The machine has a problem, so we immediately go check it.

sentences.content: 我们先找到原因，再决定怎么修。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān zhǎodào yuányīn, zài juédìng zěnme xiū.
sentences.meaning: We first find the cause, then decide how to repair it.

sentences.content: 只要认真工作，很多问题都可以解决。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào rènzhēn gōngzuò, hěn duō wèntí dōu kěyǐ jiějué.
sentences.meaning: As long as we work carefully, many problems can be solved.

sentences.content: 最近我有点累，所以每天早点睡觉。
sentences.pinyin: Zuìjìn wǒ yǒudiǎn lèi, suǒyǐ měitiān zǎodiǎn shuìjiào.
sentences.meaning: Recently I have been a little tired, so I go to bed earlier every day.

sentences.content: 我也每天喝很多水。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yě měitiān hē hěn duō shuǐ.
sentences.meaning: I also drink plenty of water every day.

sentences.content: 身体健康比什么都重要。
sentences.pinyin: Shēntǐ jiànkāng bǐ shénme dōu zhòngyào.
sentences.meaning: Good health is more important than anything.

sentences.content: 我以前不喜欢运动。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián bù xǐhuan yùndòng.
sentences.meaning: I didn't like exercising before.

sentences.content: 现在我每周跑步三次。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ měi zhōu pǎobù sān cì.
sentences.meaning: Now I run three times a week.

sentences.content: 运动以后，我觉得精神多了。
sentences.pinyin: Yùndòng yǐhòu, wǒ juéde jīngshen duō le.
sentences.meaning: After exercising, I feel much more energetic.

sentences.content: 除了运动，我还注意每天的饮食。
sentences.pinyin: Chúle yùndòng, wǒ hái zhùyì měitiān de yǐnshí.
sentences.meaning: Besides exercise, I also pay attention to my daily diet.

sentences.content: 我少喝甜饮料，多吃蔬菜和水果。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shǎo hē tián yǐnliào, duō chī shūcài hé shuǐguǒ.
sentences.meaning: I drink fewer sweet drinks and eat more vegetables and fruit.

sentences.content: 这样做虽然不容易，但是对身体很好。
sentences.pinyin: Zhèyàng zuò suīrán bù róngyì, dànshì duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
sentences.meaning: Although this is not easy, it is good for the body.

sentences.content: 下个月我准备去北京旅行。
sentences.pinyin: Xià ge yuè wǒ zhǔnbèi qù Běijīng lǚxíng.
sentences.meaning: Next month I plan to travel to Beijing.

sentences.content: 我已经买好了火车票。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng mǎi hǎo le huǒchē piào.
sentences.meaning: I have already bought the train ticket.

sentences.content: 出发以前，我还要准备行李。
sentences.pinyin: Chūfā yǐqián, wǒ hái yào zhǔnbèi xíngli.
sentences.meaning: Before leaving, I still need to prepare my luggage.

sentences.content: 到了北京以后，我先去酒店。
sentences.pinyin: Dàole Běijīng yǐhòu, wǒ xiān qù jiǔdiàn.
sentences.meaning: After arriving in Beijing, I will first go to the hotel.

sentences.content: 第二天我想去看看长城。
sentences.pinyin: Dì èr tiān wǒ xiǎng qù kànkan Chángchéng.
sentences.meaning: The next day I want to go see the Great Wall.

sentences.content: 如果时间够，我们也可以去博物馆。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ shíjiān gòu, wǒmen yě kěyǐ qù bówùguǎn.
sentences.meaning: If there is enough time, we can also go to a museum.

sentences.content: 这次旅行让我学到了很多东西。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng ràng wǒ xuédào le hěn duō dōngxi.
sentences.meaning: This trip taught me many things.

sentences.content: 我觉得旅行不只是看风景。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juéde lǚxíng bù zhǐshì kàn fēngjǐng.
sentences.meaning: I think traveling is not only about seeing scenery.

sentences.content: 认识不同的人和地方也很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: Rènshi bùtóng de rén hé dìfang yě hěn yǒu yìsi.
sentences.meaning: Meeting different people and places is also very interesting.

rules.content: 吗 (ma) is added to the end of a yes/no question. Example: 你是学生吗？(Nǐ shì xuésheng ma?) — Are you a student?
不 (bù) usually comes before a verb or adjective to make it negative. Before a fourth-tone syllable, 不 is commonly pronounced bú. Example: 我不去。(Wǒ bú qù.) — I am not going.
的 (de) commonly links a possessor to something owned, and can also describe a noun. Example: 我的书 (wǒ de shū) — my book.
过 (guo), placed after a verb, indicates a past experience. Example: 我去过北京。(Wǒ qùguo Běijīng.) — I have been to Beijing.
正在 (zhèngzài) comes before a verb to emphasize that an action is in progress. Example: 我正在学习。(Wǒ zhèngzài xuéxí.) — I am studying right now.
比 (bǐ) introduces the comparison standard. Common pattern: A + 比 + B + adjective. Example: 今天比昨天冷。(Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān lěng.) — Today is colder than yesterday.

把 (bǎ) introduces an object before the verb when the sentence focuses on what is done to that object. The verb phrase usually needs additional information about the result, direction, or action. Example: 请把门关上。(Qǐng bǎ mén guān shàng.) — Please close the door.
虽然 (suīrán) means “although.” It is often paired with 但是 (dànshì, “but”), though 但是 can be omitted. Example: 虽然很累，但是我还要学习。— Although I am tired, I still need to study.
只要 (zhǐyào) means “as long as” and introduces a sufficient condition. Example: 只要努力，就会进步。— As long as you work hard, you will improve.
